# Baloo 2

- **What:** Baloo 2, version 1.700, the variable font (weights 400–800, Regular by default), by
  Ek Type; the rounded typeface for the app's own words.
- **From:** Google Fonts' repository, https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/baloo2 →
  `Baloo2[wght].ttf`, unchanged, renamed `Baloo2-Variable.ttf` here (square brackets in an
  asset's name are awkward in Unity's search); sha256
  `d47a6852548059b1db49a1319d06d499d546c3fa2237cf9eee9c43c8abb025c2`.
- **Licence:** SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE.txt`, the repository's `OFL.txt`); no Reserved
  Font Name. The app builds a TextMeshPro atlas from it (`Assets/Scolita/Fonts/Baloo2 SDF.asset`).
- **Downloaded:** 2026-11-24, by the `project-skeleton` brief.
